result.instructions: Tools for FieldEdge, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which work orders are still open and have no technician assigned?"; "Find the customer with phone number +14155552671 and show their notes."; "List the service agreements whose next service date is in the next 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FieldEdge data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fieldedge_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fieldedge_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fieldedge_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fieldedge_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_work_orders
tools.title: List work orders
tools.description: List work orders (jobs) of the company with status, service address, customer, primary technician and linked invoice. Filters combine with AND; assigned=false cannot be combined with primary_tech_id. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/work-orders.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset.

completed.description: Only completed (true) or open (false) work orders.

customer_id.description: Only work orders of this service-location customer id.

invoice_added.description: Only work orders that have (true) or lack (false) an invoice.

primary_tech_id.description: Only work orders whose primary technician is this employee id.

assigned.description: Only work orders that have (true) or lack (false) a primary technician.

sort.description: Sort field, '-' prefix = descending: workOrderNumber, scheduledStart, priority.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_work_order
tools.title: Get a work order
tools.description: One work order: status, assignments, service address, task, tags and linked invoice. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_search_work_orders_by_address
tools.title: Find work orders at an address
tools.description: Work orders at a service address, most recent first, each with its customer's name. All of address_line_1, city, state and postal_code are required. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/work-orders/search/by-address.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset.

annotations.title: Find work orders at an address

tools.name: fieldedge_list_work_order_assignments
tools.title: List a work order's technician assignments
tools.description: Technician assignments (schedule, status) on one work order. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}/assignments.

schedule_from.description: Only assignments scheduled on/after this ISO 8601 date-time.

schedule_to.description: Only assignments scheduled on/before this ISO 8601 date-time.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use the previous reply's next_offset.

annotations.title: List a work order's technician assignments

tools.name: fieldedge_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer record in FieldEdge, visible to the office staff at once. Needs an e-mail or a phone number (international format, e.g. +14155552671); marketing_email_opt_in needs an e-mail and marketing_sms_opt_in a phone number. Names are 2-50 characters without digits. Check fieldedge_search_customers first so you do not create a duplicate. Needs scope customers:write. POST /open-api/v1/customers.

marketing_email_opt_in.description: The customer agreed to marketing e-mail. Only true if they really did.

marketing_sms_opt_in.description: The customer agreed to marketing SMS. Only true if they really did.

tools.name: fieldedge_create_customer_note
tools.title: Add a note to a customer
tools.description: WRITE: add a free-text note to a customer record; office staff see it in FieldEdge at once. Needs scope customers:write. POST /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/notes.

annotations.title: Add a note to a customer

tools.name: fieldedge_update_customer_note
tools.title: Edit a customer note
tools.description: WRITE: replace the text of an existing customer note (the old text is lost). Get the note id from fieldedge_list_customer_notes. Needs scope customers:write. PATCH /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/notes/{noteId}.

tools.name: fieldedge_create_tag
tools.title: Create a customer tag
tools.description: WRITE: create a reusable customer tag (e.g. "VIP Customer"). Check fieldedge_list_tags first. Needs scope customers:write. POST /open-api/v1/tags.

tools.name: fieldedge_add_customer_tag
tools.title: Tag a customer
tools.description: WRITE: attach an existing tag to a customer; it shows on the customer record in FieldEdge. Needs scope customers:write. POST /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/tags.

tools.name: fieldedge_remove_customer_tag
tools.title: Remove a tag from a customer
tools.description: WRITE: detach a tag from a customer (the tag itself stays). Needs scope customers:write. DELETE /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/tags/{tagId}.

annotations.title: Remove a tag from a customer

tools.name: fieldedge_create_work_order
tools.title: Create a work order
tools.description: WRITE: create a work order for a customer location. business_unit_id, lead_source_id and task_id are required: get them from fieldedge_list_business_units, fieldedge_list_lead_sources and fieldedge_list_tasks. Scheduling, invoice lines and equipment are separate steps (fieldedge_assign_technician for scheduling). Needs scope workorders:write. POST /open-api/v1/work-orders.

customer_id.description: Customer location id the work order is for.

work_order_number.description: Work order name/number; FieldEdge generates one when omitted.

primary_tech_id.description: Employee id of the primary technician to pre-assign.

document_type.description: Document the work order generates (default Normal).

work_description.description: Description of the work to be performed.

notes.description: Internal notes (the Work Summary in FieldEdge).

require_equipment.description: Equipment must be assigned before completion (default false).

tools.name: fieldedge_update_work_order
tools.title: Update a work order
tools.description: WRITE: partially update a work order; only the fields you pass change. Can reassign the primary technician, change description/notes, and mark it completed (with a resolution) or cancel it (cancel_note). Look at fieldedge_get_work_order first. Needs scope workorders:write. PATCH /open-api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}.

cancel_note.description: Reason, when cancelling the work order.

tools.name: fieldedge_assign_technician
tools.title: Assign a technician to a work order
tools.description: WRITE: schedule a technician on a work order. The assignment appears on the Dispatch Board at once and FieldEdge returns no assignment id: list the assignments afterwards to find it. Needs scope workorders:write. POST /open-api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}/assignments.

technician_id.description: Employee id of the technician (fieldedge_list_employees with role Technician).

schedule_date_time.description: Scheduled start, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-08-17T12:58:00Z.

annotations.title: Assign a technician to a work order

tools.name: fieldedge_update_assignment_status
tools.title: Change a technician assignment's status
tools.description: WRITE: move an assignment to pending, traveling, working, paused, completed or canceled. It triggers the same customer notifications and dispatch-board updates as a change on the dispatch board and is timestamped now. Canceling needs cancel_note; it fails once the assignment is completed, canceled or finalized. Get the assignment id from fieldedge_list_work_order_assignments. Needs scope workorders:write. PATCH /open-api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}/assignments/{assignmentId}/status.

cancel_note.description: Required when status is canceled; not allowed otherwise.

tools.name: fieldedge_remove_assignment
tools.title: Remove a technician from a work order
tools.description: WRITE: unassign one technician (by assignment id) from a work order; other technicians on it stay. Get the assignment id from fieldedge_list_work_order_assignments. Needs scope workorders:write. DELETE /open-api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}/assignments/{assignmentId}.

annotations.title: Remove a technician from a work order
